note: L packages F_n as the full sum of L2 spaces over tagged sectors (symmetric transverse waves are a predicate, PhysicalWave) instead of tensor powers of K_n. L's projector at k=0 is delta (0/0=0 in Lean), where M sets it to zero; the origin is a null set for the measure and no statement sees the difference.

structure Comparison (F : Spec.Final C a S) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient m) : Prop where
    ambient v : PhysicalWave (U v)
    unit : U F.action.operators.vacuum=vacuum m
    translates (v : F.action.operators.H) (b : E4) : ∀ᵐ x∂sumMeasure m,
      U (F.action.action.orbit.translation b v) x = Probe.plane (forward x) b * U v x
